summary: Aico selection-bus reads and explicit delivery.

help:
Usage: selection [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Selection bus: current selection and recent history (Aico).

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  current  Most recent captured selection (`{kind: "empty"}` when none).
  history  Recent selections, newest first.
  send     Write a capture to the selection bus — the CLI/desktop source.
help.current:
Usage: selection current [OPTIONS]

  Most recent captured selection (`{kind: "empty"}` when none).

  Examples: st selection current | st selection current --human

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.history:
Usage: selection history [OPTIONS]

  Recent selections, newest first.

  Examples: st selection history | st selection history --n 5

Options:
  -n, --n <int>  Max selections to return (newest first)  [default: 10]
  --help         Show this message and exit.
help.send:
Usage: selection send [OPTIONS] {kind}

  Write a capture to the selection bus — the CLI/desktop source.

  Captures come from `st ui`; this verb puts one on the bus. Default delivers
  to the active Aico widget (the explicit-gesture path); --no-deliver stores
  only (harvested later via the hotkey). The kind is validated by the sidecar.

  Examples:   st ui shot -w aico -o /tmp/x.png && st selection send region -s
  /tmp/x.png   st ui ocr aico | st selection send region --stdin

Arguments:
  kind  Selection kind: dom | a11y | region  [required]

Options:
  -s, --snippet <str>  Snippet text or file path
  --stdin              Read the snippet from stdin
  --meta <str>         Extra meta as a JSON object
  --no-deliver         Store only; do not push to the active widget
  --help               Show this message and exit.

usage.when: read the selection explicitly shared through Aico
precautions: A missing sidecar reports an empty selection, not verified availability.

usage.when: deliver an authorized capture to the active Aico widget
precautions: Sends content to the active widget by default; --no-deliver only stores it. Effect metadata is not authorization to share content.
